hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash mkdir ${STUDY_ID} cd ${STUDY_ID} conn_user='postgres' conn_pass=`aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id 'rds!db-2b115560-c8c4-4cec-8418-537a35f9c192' --region 'us-east-1' --query SecretString --output text | jq -r .password` database_psql_host_address='recoverdb.cljahwnkfisu.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com' #phs003461 is 3 studies in a single phs trench coat so merge the meta mkdir merged #pediatric PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --username="$conn_user" --dbname="recover_pediatrics_${VERSION}" --csv -Atc \ "select json_agg(meta) from metadata_output.metadata meta" -o recover_pediatric_metadata.json #congenital PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --username="$conn_user" --dbname="recover_congenital_${VERSION}" --csv -Atc \ "select json_agg(meta) from metadata_output.metadata meta" -o recover_congenital_metadata.json #caregiver PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --username="$conn_user" --dbname="recover_caregiver_${VERSION}" --csv -Atc \ "select json_agg(meta) from metadata_output.metadata meta" -o recover_caregiver_metadata.json jq -s 'add' recover_pediatric_metadata.json recover_congenital_metadata.json recover_caregiver_metadata.json > merged/phs003461_recover_pediatric_metadata.json
aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` rm -f assume-role-output.txt aws s3 cp merged/phs003461_recover_pediatric_metadata.json s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${STUDY_ABV,,}/decoded_data/ aws s3 cp merged/phs003461_recover_pediatric_metadata.json s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/hpds/javabin/${STUDY_ID}/metadata/phs003461_recover_pediatric_metadata.json unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
